summary: Iter-132: Verified two GHG edit/approval fixes. Fix #2 (approval handler mapping 'inputs' → 'dynamic_field_values') WORKS correctly – E2E test confirms that after admin approves a non-admin edit, dynamic_field_values.qty and co2e_emissions are updated with the proposed values. Fix #1 (submitter sees own pending edit in GET /api/emissions/{id}) DOES NOT WORK – the submitter still sees the old approved value instead of their proposed value. Skipped frontend UI testing because the backend contract for the primary user-visible symptom (edit form pre-populated with wrong values) is still broken.

critical.issue: Non-admin submitter still sees APPROVED values, NOT their pending proposed values. Reproduced end-to-end: Aman PUT qty 5000→5007 succeeds and creates approval_requests entry with proposed_changes.inputs.qty.value=5007, but subsequent GET /api/emissions/{id} as Aman returns dynamic_field_values.qty=5000 (approval_status=pending_approval). Fix in emissions/router.py:1451-1462 queries PENDING_COLLECTION (='pending_records') by original_record_id+submitted_by, but the current PUT flow (_create_emission_update_approval_request / _update_existing_approval_request) never inserts into pending_records — it stores proposed_changes in db.approval_requests.entity_snapshot.proposed_changes. So the pending-edit lookup always misses and falls through to the approved record.

integration_issues.issue: Because GET /api/emissions/{id} still returns approved values for the submitter, the edit form for a non-admin user with a pending edit will continue to show the approved values, which is the exact symptom the user reported. Frontend UI test skipped – contract at API layer must be fixed first.

action_items: Fix get_emission_record in /app/backend/modules/emissions/router.py (line ~1451-1462): change the pending-edit lookup to query db.approval_requests where entity_type='emission_record', entity_id=record_id, submitted_by=user_id, status in ['pending','in_review']. Then merge approval_req['entity_snapshot']['proposed_changes']['inputs'] into the record's dynamic_field_values (and outputs / co2e_emissions from proposed_changes.outputs) so the submitter's edit form shows their proposed values.
Alternative: also merge proposed_changes.outputs into co2e_emissions/co2_emissions/... so the calculated fields on the response are consistent.
Verify that admins fetching the same endpoint continue to see the approved (not proposed) values (already validated in this iteration).
After fix, re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ghg_edit_e2e_iter132.py to confirm submitter sees proposed values.
critical_code_review_comments: Two parallel emission approval mechanisms coexist in the codebase (legacy pending_records via modules/approvals/emission_flow_v2.py and unified approval_requests via modules/approval_workflow). The current PUT handler writes only to approval_requests but several helpers (find_record, fetch_emissions_for_user) still read from PENDING_COLLECTION. This split is fragile and caused the current bug. Recommend consolidating to a single mechanism.

router.py get_emission_record: even after fix #1, non-admin users only see submitted_by == self pending edits. If two users share a KPI assignment, one user's pending proposal is invisible to the other. Consider showing has_pending_proposal indicator (already implemented for list endpoint) on the single-record endpoint too.

In _update_existing_approval_request the record is mutated in-place for 'create' request_type but not for 'update'. This means UPDATE approvals rely entirely on the approval_requests snapshot as the source of truth for the submitter's proposal – which is the exact reason fix #1 must read from that collection.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Non-admin user's pending edit values are NOT shown in the GHG edit form.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1) Login as Aman (goyalsomil+1@hotmail.com). 2) PUT /api/emissions/23ee8d0e-3c3e-48d4-b201-b1db111e2a2e with dynamic_field_values.qty.value=5007 (original 5000). Returns 200 with approval_status=pending_approval. 3) GET /api/approval-workflows/requests?status=pending as admin returns the request with entity_snapshot.proposed_changes.inputs.qty.value=5007 (proof the proposal is stored). 4) GET /api/emissions/23ee8d0e... as Aman returns dynamic_field_values.qty.value=5000 (approved value, BUG).
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The fix in get_emission_record queries db['pending_records'] by original_record_id + submitted_by. But the current PUT handler (_create_emission_update_approval_request in emissions/router.py:462) writes only to db.approval_requests, never to pending_records. So the lookup always misses and returns the approved emission_records document unchanged.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Rewrite the non-admin pending-edit lookup in get_emission_record to query db.approval_requests: `await db.approval_requests.find_one({'entity_type':'emission_record', 'entity_id': record_id, 'submitted_by': user_id, 'status': {'$in':['pending','in_review']}})`. Then overlay entity_snapshot.proposed_changes.inputs onto record.dynamic_field_values (and proposed_changes.outputs on co2*_emissions) before returning.
